messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 39):
"""
I also certify that, in my opinion, the premium rates, advantages, terms and conditions of the above product are workable and sound, the assumptions are reasonable and premium rates are fair and the rates proposed are viable. It is further to confirm that the product is in compliance with the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations, 2024." Place Signature of the Appointed Actuary Date: CERTIFICATE BY CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER: I ____________________________________ (Name of CCO) hereby solemnly declare that the information filed in respect of the above Group Insurance Product is as cleared by PMC and being marketed without any variation. We undertake to file the product afresh if there is any variation in the product filed above. Signature of the Chief Compliance Officer Place Date: Name and Counter Signature of the principal officer along with name, and Company’s seal.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
